title: customer escalation war room - ZenStore - 2026-03-04
summary: Prep and notes for war-room with ZenStore re: production errors and elevated latency on hosted inference endpoints. Goal: triage root cause, stabilize customer traffic, and assign action items for follow-up and postmortem.
impact_snapshot: Start: 2026-03-03 22:10 UTC - elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints for ZenStore org (org id zns-110). Affected ~30% of requests, P95 latency increased from 120ms to 2.3s. Customer reports failed batch jobs and several user-facing errors. Business impact: checkout failures in ZenStore storefront during peak window (EMEA ramp).
current_hypotheses: Recent config change to batching thresholds caused head-of-line latency for long sequences
KV cache invalidation issue after auto-refresh leading to cache miss storm
Autoscaler lag / capacity fragmentation in EMEA region causing queueing
Client retry storm from ZenStore SDK exacerbating backend load
evidence_collected: Metrics: spike in 5xx and 429 between 22:10-22:45 UTC; P95 token latency 2.3s
Logs: repeated "KVCacheMiss" entries correlated with high latencies (see log sample in JIRA-INC-7821)
Deploys: small config rollout at 21:58 UTC that touched batching/timeout settings (PR #1234)
Customer: ZenStore confirms they rolled out new SDK 2.1.0 at 21:50 UTC with aggressive retries
mitigation_options: Rollback config rollout PR #1234 immediately (Ravi) - fastest path if config confirmed)
Temporarily increase capacity in eu-west-1 for ZenStore pool (Infra) to reduce queuing
Apply temporary rate-limit/exponential backoff on ZenStore API key via routing policy
Patch SDK guidance: ask ZenStore to disable aggressive client retries while we investigate
Enable additional KV cache telemetry and bump cache warm-up priority for ZenStore org
decisions_made: Ravi to enact rollback of batching config (target: 10m for rollback + verification)
Infra to spin up + pin 2 additional dedicated instances in eu-west-1 for zns-110 (hotfix)
Support (Sophie) to coordinate immediate customer communication and provide status updates every 30m
Disable canary rollout for API gate for ZenStore traffic until postmortem (Miguel)
Create postmortem doc and assign owners (see action items)
action_items: Ravi Patel - rollback PR #1234; verify reduced 5xx and P95 returns to baseline; ETA: 2026-03-04 22:25 UTC
Infra on-call - spin up 2 pinned instances in eu-west-1 for zns-110, validate routing; ETA: 2026-03-04 22:35 UTC
Daniel Park - collect and post detailed traces and flamegraphs to JIRA-INC-7821; include sample spans and timeline; ETA: 2026-03-04 23:00 UTC
Sophie Martin - send status update to ZenStore (Tom Ellis) w/actions taken and expected recovery window; include interim workaround (disable SDK retries); ETA: 2026-03-04 22:40 UTC
Leah Chen - schedule executive update and loop in account team + sales lead; prepare 1-pager for ZenStore execs; ETA: 2026-03-05 09:00 UTC
Miguel Santos - create postmortem draft in Confluence and assign owners for RCA sections; ETA: 2026-03-05 12:00 UTC
communication_plan: Immediate: Support message to customer with summary and actions (Sophie). External-facing incident page TBD if broader customer impact emerges. Internal Slack #inc-7821 channel for live updates. Exec sync if incident not fully resolved within 3 hours.
follow_up: Short follow up meeting scheduled 2026-03-05 10:00 UTC (30m) to review telemetry after rollback and discuss next steps + long-term mitigations.
notes: If rollback does not reduce 5xx within 15m after completion, escalate to kernel-level tracing and consider emergency scale + diversion
Watch for secondary effects: increased tail latency for other customers when spinning up pinned instances - monitor cost and SLOs
Document SDK retry rates and suggest client-side exponential backoff in SDK 2.1.1
Keep ticket JIRA-INC-7821 as source-of-truth for runbook, logs, links
